bibliographic.title: Neapolitan
bibliographic.author: Rylie Eric
bibliographic.description:
Neapolitan is a collection of three mostly linear stories from previous game jams that I had to cancel, finally revived for the Revival Jam 2024.

Vanilla - A fictional take on the creation of Ice Cream Clicker almost 5 years ago.  Revived from Return To Your Roots jam.

Chocolate - Milo looks for closure with his ex. Either with her or without, he will figure something out eventually. Revived from Get a Glass of Milk Because You Have To's cancelled spin off Cheesecake/Red Velvet Cake, with restrictions revived from Trans Representation Jam 22.

Strawberry - Twins meet to reflect over hardships and strawberries. Revived from the various gift jams that happened throughout 2023.
